verdicts.reason: A puts the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline, so the reading order is broken. Its flavour chips are reversed and jammed against each other, and the body copy is squeezed into a tiny two-line fragment beside them. The oversized CTA is pushed against the right edge while the decorative circles leave dead space on the left. B keeps a sensible order (brand, headline, then copy, CTA and evenly spaced chips in the original sequence), but the headline is jammed against the left and bottom edges and the right cluster feels detached from it.
